speak.title: Role-play: is the cheap package worth it?
speak.setup: Work in pairs. Read your card, then have the conversation. Swap roles and do it again.

a.text: Your friend wants to fly to Istanbul for a hair transplant because it's much cheaper. You're worried. Ask about the clinic, the surgeon and the help after the operation. Say what you'd do.

b.text: You've found a cheap package in Istanbul with a hotel and airport transfers. You want to book it this week. Explain why it's a good deal and answer your friend's worries.

phrases: I've found a much cheaper package in Istanbul.
What happens if something goes wrong when I'm home?
Have you checked the surgeon's qualifications?
I'd feel safer if we shopped around first.
I'm not trying to push you into it.
Could we compromise and wait a month?
speak.after: Afterwards, tell the class: did the traveller decide to book, wait or look for another clinic?
